It explicitly lists property location, cadastral block plan, subdivision plan, roads, and aerial imagery, and directs users to the municipal geoprocessing portal. This is local municipal custodian evidence, not merely general agency prose.

officialLeads.operator: Prefeitura do Município de Piracicaba geoprocessing portal
officialLeads.observation: Current public map HTML and JavaScript were inspected. ServerURLs.js identifies the municipal WMS at https://geo.piracicaba.sp.gov.br/app/geoserver/glue_piracicaba/wms, REST base /app/glue-piracicaba_server/rest/json, and the configured current layer name Lotes. The configuration is evidence of an official parcel/lots map route, not a returned feature sample.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Municipal cadastral service page states that cadastral property location and quadra/lote plans are available through the municipal geoprocessing portal. No personal or owner fields were requested.
Public map application loaded. Its HTML references current JavaScript/configuration files used for the official viewer.
Configuration exposed the official WMS URL, REST base, municipal data host, map center, and configured layer name Lotes. No credentials, private token, or login was used.
Anonymous REST health/configuration probe succeeded. It did not return parcel IDs or geometry.
Anonymous layer-tree request with profile 0 returned no usable JSON, so layer schema and native identity fields could not be established.
Anonymous map-layer request with profile 0 returned no usable JSON; no feature query was fabricated from the empty response.
Official configured WMS capabilities request did not complete. This is not evidence of absence or of map extent miss.
